title: HTML Entity Parser
summary: Implement an HTML entity parser that converts special character entities in an input string to their corresponding symbols.
statement: Implement an HTML entity parser that converts special character entities in an input string to their corresponding symbols. The entities to be parsed are: quotation marks ("), single quotes ('), ampersand (&), greater than sign (>), less than sign (<), and slash (⁄). The parser should replace each entity with its respective symbol.
constraints: Unknown or incomplete entity-like text remains unchanged; replacements are not parsed a second time.
hints: Scan left to right and test the six complete entity spellings at an ampersand.
Append the mapped character and skip the full token on a match.
Otherwise copy one source character unchanged.
Because consumed source is never rescanned, nested-looking text is decoded only once.
editorial: Because consumed source is never rescanned, nested-looking text is decoded only once.

arguments: & is an HTML entity but &ambassador; is not.
tests.expected: & is an HTML entity but &ambassador; is not.
tests.explanation: Neither ampersand begins one of the six complete recognized entities.
The three recognized tokens become x > y && y < z.
